model: vQ Stream unit with Carel uPC3 controller
applies_to: FläktGroup vQ Stream ventilation units controlled by a Carel uPC3 controller.
summary: The vQ Stream unit's Carel uPC3 controller publishes one variable list for Modbus, BACnet IP and OPC-UA. The BACnet side has Analog, Binary, Positive Integer and Integer Values: probe readings, outputs, setpoints, fan monitoring (up to 10 supply and 10 return fans), scheduler entries, unit configuration parameters, energy values and about 1,500 alarm flags (trigger and active bits per alarm).
notes: Object names are the uPC3 variable names (the workbook's OPC-UA DisplayName repeats them).
Descriptions start with a group tag: IO inputs/outputs, MO monitoring, SP setpoints, PAR parameters, SCH scheduler, SYS system, CLK clock, CT counters, ECO energy, AL alarms.
Most alarms have two flags, .Trigger and .Active.
Objects for fans 2-10, extra coils and options a unit does not have are still listed.
Access is printed as Read or ReadWrite; ReadWrite is listed as W.
BV 25 UnitOff is described 'Unit - On' and BV 26 UnitOn 'Unit - Off'; kept as printed. BV 18 SrsAlrm.Val (global alarm output) prints 0=ON, 1=OFF.

source.title: vQ Stream - Communication list for BMS (uPC3 - BMS Variable)

integration.summary: Select the BACnet port (BV 1680: Ethernet or pLAN) and network settings in the controller, then command the unit with PIV 397 SetTyp work mode and the per-mode setpoints, and read supply and return temperatures, fan running flags and the global alarm. BV 845 resets alarms from the BMS.

minimum_points.name: SetTyp
minimum_points.why: Work mode: 0 Off, 1 Eco, 2 Optimal, 3 Comfort, 5 Auto

minimum_points.name: AlarmMng.AlrmResByBms
minimum_points.why: Alarm reset from the BMS (1 = reset)

integration.enable: PIV 397 SetTyp (ReadWrite) is the work-mode selection; 5 = Auto follows the unit's scheduler. The setpoints used in each mode are the UnitSetP.* AVs (Economy, Optimal/PreComfort, Comfort, Standby).
setup: BV 1680 BacNetSel chooses the BACnet port: 0 = Ethernet, 1 = pLAN.
Units of measure (international or USA) are set with IV 686 Uom_Msk; temperature and flow units follow it.
gotchas: Many PAR/SYS objects are configuration parameters; do not write them cyclically.
Alarm flags come in .Trigger and .Active pairs; map one set.
